title: Military abductions of abductees after gray abductions
place_text: Air Force bases and underground bases, USA

tellings.quote: some of these abductees were being would be abducted by gray aliens and then when they were turn returned to their homes the military would show up

plain: Tim Alberino, a researcher speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast and drawing on the work of abduction researcher Karla Turner, says some people were taken by gray aliens, small grey-skinned beings, and then returned home. He says the military would then show up and take these same people again, to Air Force bases and underground bases. If true, the military knows about the abductions and is following up on the people involved.
